name: Shanghai Chengtou Holding Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Chengtou Holding Co.,Ltd operates primarily in China's property development sector. The company constructs a range of properties, including commercial and affordable residential units, retail and business complexes, and science and technology parks. Additionally, it develops and manages rental housing. Beyond real estate construction, its services extend to building renovation projects, equity investment, and the management of private equity funds. This firm was established in 1992 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
